<notes>
kept -> base harness -> base1 delivered correct format and systematic evaluation in 1 step with no tool errors, format violations, or mechanical failures; the trajectory shows the agent working through all five expressions with explicit reasoning and delivering a result

Both candidate harnesses show "(no change)" in their diffs and their file contents are identical to the base harness. Neither candidate proposes a harness modification, despite generating different model outputs. These are variant samples from the same code, not evidence of harness defect.

No trajectory moment in any rollout shows the harness failing to load, execute, or format output. No repeated concrete failure pattern exists across runs. The base harness successfully completed the task in 1 call.

The mission rule applies: "An edit earns its place when a SPECIFIC MOMENT in a trajectory shows the mechanism." Without candidates proposing changes and without a demonstrated harness failure, any modification would be speculation that costs context without evidence of need. KEEP_BASE is the appropriate decision.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
